float and do not swim against the current. If able, swim parallel
to the shoreline. If unable to escape, face the shore and call or
wave for help.

* Air temperatures in the lower 60s to lower 70s this weekend (50s
on Sunday) may cause people to underestimate the dangers of the
cold water temperatures which are currently only in the mid 50s
across Sebago Lake and Lake Winnipesaukee, and in the mid 50s in

anyone immersed in the water. When the water temperature is below
60 degrees, the average submerged person could loose dexterity
within minutes and be unable to accomplish simple tasks. Anyone
on small boats, canoes, or kayaks should plan accordingly if
recreating this weekend and use extreme caution to avoid this
threat. Paddle smart from the start and always wear your life
jacket!

out of the south on Saturday. Winds will be breezy on Saturday with
some gusts up to 25 mph. If boating on large bodies of water,
these strong winds can increase the likelihood of overturning your
boat, canoe, or kayak due to increased wave heights.

properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in

.Multiple rounds of heavy rainfall to start the week will bring
minor lowland river flooding to Mount Carmel on the Wabash River as
water routes downstream from the White River. More rounds of
rainfall going into and through the holiday weekend could make the
flooding last longer and bring a higher crest.

* WHERE...Wabash River at Mount Carmel.

* WHEN...From late tonight to Friday, May 29.

oil field production ceases with the exception of pumping units on
substructures.  Access to these are by boat only.  Agricultural
losses increase dramatically.  Farmers move livestock to higher
ground.  City of Mount Carmel leaves flood gates B and C in year
round.

- At 10:45 AM EDT Friday /9:45 AM CDT Friday/ the stage was
18.2 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage
late tonight to a crest of 20.4 feet early Monday afternoon.

- Flood stage is 19.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:

occur in automobiles. Do not attempt to cross water covered bridges,
dips, or low water crossings. Never try to cross a flowing stream,
even a small one, on foot. To escape rising water find another route
over higher ground.

dangers of flooding.

properties.areaDesc: Yap; Melekeok; Airai; Koror; Peleliu; Angaur
properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued May 22 at 4:08PM ChST by NWS Tiyan GU
properties.description:
A tropical disturbance, known as JTWC's Invest 99W, is currently
centered near 7N147E west of Weno, Chuuk. This system is starting to
develop and is expected to move to the west-northwest as it moves
through the outer islands of Yap State. The chance of this system
developing into a significant tropical cyclone is rated as sub-low by
Joint Typhoon Warning Center (JTWC). Current estimations has the
system passing by or over Fais and Ulithi before moving northward
into the Philippine Sea. This system is expected to bring numerous to
widespread showers with possible heavy down pours, gusty winds and
choppy seas. In addition, high uncertainty remains regarding rainfall
amounts, but model trends indicate 3 to 5 inches over the next 72
hours. Yap Proper and Palau may also experience this disturbance as
models are not in alignment on when the northward turn is anticipated
to happen.

As of this writing, combined seas are expected to become choppier,
however remaining below 22 knot winds and 10 foot sea conditions.

Residents are urged to pay close attention the next few days to your
local emergency management, the National Weather Service Guam web
page (which can be found at www.weather.gov/gum), information put
out by Weather Service Offices Yap and Palau, and our social media
pages.

properties.description:
ESFAFG

...Locations Impacted...
Yukon Delta

As of Thursday evening, an Ice Jam near Russian Mission continues to
back up water from Russian Mission to Anvik. When the ice jam
eventually releases this water will flow towards the Yukon Delta.
Most large Yukon River ice jams during recent years decay, erode and
fail within a few days. The current jam at Russian Mission has been
in place for over 4 days. Water levels are expected to quickly rise
as the backwater makes its way downriver impacting communities like
Emmonak, Alakanuk, Nunam Iqua, and Kotlik.
